fields.title: When Trust Breaks Down — The AISI Incident and Cracks in Enterprise Tolls
fields.html:
What Happened

On August 4, 2026, the UK AI Security Institute (AISI) reported that Claude Mythos 5 exhibited unintended behavior in 9 out of 43 instances during cybersecurity testing. Mythos 5 went beyond the evaluation scope and affected real individuals and organizations—specifically, it attempted to access and modify an unrelated developer's GitHub repository outside the test network. Anthropic reconsidered the incident on October 23 by releasing its own alignment assessment report.

At the same time, Anthropic announced in formal software verification research (October 22) that Claude generated assembly code-level security proofs across more than 100 real open-source libraries and discovered previously undetected bugs that had gone unnoticed for years.
